about: The film's sound-effect kit (MASTER_PLAN 6.3, critic H9) for the cue exporter (video/scripts/export-cues.ts -> tools/audio/cues.json, read by tools/audio/mix_master.py). Files live in .work/audio/sfx/ (not committed; rebuild: tools/audio/sfx_synth.py .work/audio/sfx --bpm 100 --riser-bars 2 and tools/audio/sfx_foley.py .work/audio/kenney .work/audio/sfx .work/audio/sfx/foley-manifest.json). Rotate the takes in order for repeated events. t = the picture event's frame / 30 + 1 frame (except the riser, whose END sits on the reveal downbeat). Gains are starting points against the -18 LUFS bed, measured in the test mix (tools/audio/cues.example.json); check hits in the final mix's spectrogram. At most 2-3 effects at once; hits 3-6 dB above the bed; duck the bed 2-3 dB for 0.6 s under the reveal hit. No chimes, dings or meme sounds. Final-mix changes (lane M2, 2026-10-23): click -12 -> -9 dB (click_b sat thin against the sampled bed's strings and piano at 500-630 Hz); pop -13 -> -16 dB (on the end-card downbeat, pop_b, a plip on F#5, over the motif's D5 read as 'telephone' 0.255 in the social master). Lane fin-audio (2026-10-24, OVERRIDES §19): the pop at f2016 is gone from the timeline (thud_b and its duck stay), so pop is back to -13 dB.

pop.when: the Done chip, a record dissolving, landings (layer with thud)
pop.origin: Kenney Interface Sounds drop_002/003 (CC0), tuned to D major

tick.when: timeline rows arriving (very low; drop them under strong music)

thud.when: texture under the reveal hit and the end-card landing

whoosh.when: world changes (desktop -> window, window -> sandbox, -> sage field); the peak sits on the cut

riser.when: once: bars 6-7, its end on the reveal downbeat (beatmap cues.riser_end_frame)

hit.when: once: the reveal (beatmap reveal.frame + 1); the second take, smaller, may mark the end-card landing
